en: Illustrated view of a bustling market square surrounded by multi-storey historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. Numerous vendors stand at stalls under white umbrellas selling produce, while townspeople in early 20th-century clothing walk among them. A statue stands on a pedestal in the middle of the square. In the background on a hill rises a prominent clock tower. The right margin bears printed text "Graz, Hauptplatz" indicating the scene as the main square of Graz. Shop signs on the buildings include German words such as "DAMEN-HUT-SALON" and "CAFÉ".
